mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the current unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals market anticipation of aggressive policy support, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases month-over-month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2050 thousand units signals strong residential investment and consumer confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2050, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), increased borrowing costs reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates improving labor market conditions and increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
